001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.types;
002
003import java.util.ArrayList;
004import java.util.List;
005
006import org.lwjgl.util.vector.Vector2f;
007
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.Global;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.CampaignFleetAPI;
010import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.BaseSensorGhostCreator;
011import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.GhostFrequencies;
012import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.SensorGhost;
013import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.SensorGhostManager;
014import com.fs.starfarer.api.util.Misc;
015
016public class RemoraGhostCreator extends BaseSensorGhostCreator {
017
018        @Override
019        public List<SensorGhost> createGhost(SensorGhostManager manager) {
020                if (!Global.getSector().getCurrentLocation().isHyperspace()) return null;
021                CampaignFleetAPI pf = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
022                
023                float f = GhostFrequencies.getFringeFactor();
024                int numRemora = 1 + manager.getRandom().nextInt(Math.round(f * 4f) + 1);
025                
026                List<SensorGhost> result = new ArrayList<SensorGhost>();
027                
028                float dur = 7f + manager.getRandom().nextFloat() * 5f;
029
030                Vector2f first = null;
031                for (int i = 0; i < numRemora; i++) {
032                        Vector2f loc = null;
033                        if (first != null) {
034                                loc = Misc.getPointWithinRadiusUniform(first, 300f, manager.getRandom());
035                        }
036                        RemoraGhost remora = new RemoraGhost(manager, pf, dur + manager.getRandom().nextFloat() * 0.5f, loc);
037                        if (!remora.isCreationFailed()) {
038                                result.add(remora);
039                                first = remora.getEntity().getLocation();
040                        }
041                }
042                
043                return result;
044        }
045
046        
047        @Override
048        public float getFrequency(SensorGhostManager manager) {
049                //return 100000f;
050                return GhostFrequencies.getRemoraFrequency(manager);
051        }
052        
053        public boolean canSpawnWhilePlayerInOrNearSlipstream() {
054                return true;
055        }
056        
057}
